---
title: "C-Plan data pipeline"
---

To promote open science and smooth updates to the C-Plan the data to documentation pipeline in @fig-dataflow was adopted.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-dataflow
%%| fig-cap: Data to documentation pipeline overview. Boxes indicate the storage and backup locations of the data and code, in the cloud and on GitHub, respectively.
%%| fig-align: center

flowchart TD

%% Group 1: cloud storage
%% === sub node ===
subgraph G1[Cloud storage]
    direction LR
    %%style G1 fill:#c4d8c282,stroke:#3d573bff,stroke-width:2px
    d([Metadata])
    e([Data])
    d <--> e
end

%% === main nodes ===
subgraph G2[GitHub code repo]
%%style G2 fill:#80a17d82,stroke:#3d573bff,stroke-width:2px
a([Metadata systems])
b([Scripts & <br> GIS software])
c([Documentation])

a --> b
b --> c

b -.-> a
c -.-> b

d --> a
e --> a
end
```
